quantitative_overrides.fin_note: Operating ROIC normalized to 25.7% (roic_operating) reflecting Walmart's tangible operating capital efficiency driven by rapid inventory turns and negative working capital retail dynamics (10Y median GAAP ROIC 18.9%). Peak Owner EPS of $2.7291 in FY2025 is clean and supported by $41.56B OCF and $23.76B Owner FCF (~108% FCF conversion) with zero non-cash earnings spikes. 5-10Y through-the-cycle growth of 5.5% reflects traffic and volume (2.0%), pricing/inflation pass-through (1.5%), high-margin retail media (Walmart Connect, $6.4B run-rate) and marketplace mix (1.5%), offset by digital supply chain robotics capex drag (-0.5%), plus net share repurchases (1.0%). Fortress balance sheet with $10.7B cash against $34.6B long-term debt (net debt / NI of ~1.1x) and strong 12.9x interest coverage. At $125.52, Walmart trades at 45.99x peak Owner EPS, exceeding its 5-year cycle high of 45.26x and standing +90.8% Above PAR value of $65.80 (24.11x PAR multiple), delivering an expected 5Y cycle IRR of -6.5% due to multiple compression headwinds.
